name: Aino Virtanen
headline: M.Sc. (Tech.)  |  Supply Chain and Sustainability

profile.tagline: I help manufacturers cut waste from their supply chains without losing delivery reliability.
profile.text: Supply chain specialist with six years of experience in procurement, logistics development and sustainability reporting in Finnish industry. Experienced in leading cross-functional projects between purchasing, production and suppliers.

experience.title: Supply Chain Development Manager
responsibilities: Lead a team of four developing supplier performance and logistics processes.
Own supplier sustainability data collection for the company's CSRD reporting.
results: Reduced inbound freight costs by 12% by consolidating shipments from 30 suppliers.
Delivered the first CSRD-aligned supplier emissions dataset on schedule in 2024.

experience.title: Purchasing Specialist
responsibilities: Managed sourcing of electronic components for three product lines.
Negotiated annual agreements with key suppliers.
results: Cut component lead times from 10 to 6 weeks by qualifying two new suppliers.

extraSections.heading: Training and Volunteering
bullets: Mentor in a university career program, 2023 – present.

certifications: APICS CSCP – Certified Supply Chain Professional, 2021

skills.text: SAP S/4HANA, Power BI, Excel (advanced), Python (basic)
